plan.title: Scholarship Applications Summary
plan.subtitle: Overview of applicant demographics, academic performance, and approval pipeline

panels.title: Overall Approval Rate
panels.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN "Status" IN ('Approved', 'Disbursed') THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS approval_rate FROM "scholarship_applicants"

panels.title: Application Status Breakdown
panels.sql: SELECT "Status" AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Status" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Applications by Scheme
panels.sql: SELECT "Name of scheme" AS scheme, COUNT(*) AS applicants FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Name of scheme" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Applicants and Average Marks by Category
panels.sql: SELECT "Category" AS category, COUNT(*) AS total_students, AVG("Marks %") AS avg_score FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Category" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: District-Wise Overview
panels.sql: SELECT "District" AS district, COUNT(*) AS total_applicants, ROUND(AVG("Marks %"), 2) AS avg_marks, ROUND(AVG("Family Income"), 0) AS avg_income, COUNT(CASE WHEN "Status" IN ('Approved', 'Disbursed') THEN 1 END) AS successful_cases FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "District" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

plan.narrative:
